insight.why_it_matters: NHR and VEL were level at 2-2 with both sides moving the ball at high completion rates, so the value of this moment is in how VEL progressed from a congested wide position into space between NHR's lines rather than in any immediate shot. VEL-07's line-breaking pass to VEL-09 was executed under 0.86 pressure and carried the largest single-event threat gain of the sequence, which is why the following pass into the final third was attempted from a more advanced position — VEL's route to the box ran through this escape from NHR's press.

The single event carried an xT gain of 0.0901, the largest of the sequence, and a pass difficulty of 6.9 against a sampled window value of 4.3803. The escape did not become a shot: VEL-02's pass from x 68.4 to x 90.8 at 72:08 was incomplete at 0.38 pressure, ending the move.
fan_cards.why_it_matters: This was not a product of NHR's passing breaking down. VEL circulated at 0.8345 pass completion against NHR's 0.8203 in the sampled phase, so progressing from a congested wide position into the space between NHR's lines required an individual escape under pressure. Because the line break was the sequence's largest threat gain, VEL's next pass into the final third was attempted from a more advanced position — the route to the box ran through this exit from NHR's press, even though the follow-up failed.

fan_cards.headline: VEL-07 rompe la línea de NHR con 0.86 de presión en el minuto 72
fan_cards.what_happened: En el 72:01, con 2-2, VEL-07 completó un pase de 23.9 m a VEL-09 bajo 0.86 de presión, etiquetado como line break y con un xt_delta de 0.0901, el mayor del secuencia. La dificultad del pase fue 6.9/10, por encima del 4.3803 del ventana muestreada. Sin embargo, VEL-02 no completó el pase siguiente desde x 68.4 a x 90.8 a 0.38 de presión en el 72:08, cerrando la acción sin remate.
fan_cards.why_it_matters: La ruptura llegó con ambos equipos circulando bien: 0.8345 de completitud de pase para VEL frente a 0.8203 de NHR. Por eso el valor está en la salida individual de VEL-07 desde banda congestionada hacia el espacio entre líneas, no en un fallo de NHR. NHR-03 aplicó 0.63 de presión en el siguiente conducción de VEL, un dato a seguir, no un patrón consolidado.
fan_cards.watch_next: Observar si NHR sostiene su contrapresión tras las rupturas de línea de VEL: la presión de NHR-03 a 0.63 en e-000955 es una señal puntual, no una tendencia establecida.
fan_cards.how_we_know: Se apoya en los eventos e-000950 y e-000951, con métricas de presión, xt_delta y dificultad de pase etiquetadas para la secuencia.

fan_cards.headline: VEL-07 slips through the gap
fan_cards.what_happened: In the 72nd minute, with the score 2-2, VEL-07 threaded a 23.9 m pass to VEL-09 right through NHR's midfield line while under pressure. The next pass forward went incomplete, so no shot came of it.

fan_cards.headline: VEL-07 encuentra el hueco en la línea del NHR
fan_cards.what_happened: Con 2-2, VEL-07 metió un pase de 23,9 metros a VEL-09 por un hueco estrecho, bajo presión del NHR. El siguiente pase largo se fue sin remate.
fan_cards.why_it_matters: Fue como encontrar una puerta en una pared: el NHR defendía ordenado y VEL necesitaba esa chispa individual para avanzar, aunque el ataque no acabó en gol.
fan_cards.watch_next: Queda por ver si el NHR mantiene su presión inmediata tras ese tipo de pases.

fan_cards.headline: 第72分钟，VEL-07从人堆里钻了出来
fan_cards.what_happened: 比分2-2，双方传球都很稳。第72分钟，VEL-07在压力下送出一脚23.9米的直塞，找到了队友VEL-09，一下穿过了NHR的防线。可惜随后那脚往前场的传球没接上，这次进攻就此结束。
fan_cards.why_it_matters: 就像挤在人群里突然找到一条缝——VEL-07这一下是VEL唯一能走到禁区前的路。
fan_cards.watch_next: 接下来可以留意：NHR丢球后会不会马上反抢。

fan_cards.what_happened: In the 72nd minute, VEL-07 took the ball in a congested wide area, stayed composed under 0.86 pressure and clipped a 23.9 m pass into VEL-09 between NHR's lines. That line break was the sequence's biggest threat gain (xT +0.0901). VEL-07's escape moved VEL into a more advanced position, though VEL-02's next pass into the final third was incomplete.
fan_cards.why_it_matters: For VEL-07, the impact was in the movement and decision: not a shot, but a pressure-beating pass that turned congestion into space and gave VEL a cleaner route toward the box.
